# netactuate_firewall_external_ipsets (Data Source)

Reads Firewall External Ipsets visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_firewall_external_ipsets" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `external_ipset_id` (Number) External IP set ID. When omitted, all external IP sets are returned.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ipsets` (List of Object) External IP sets visible to the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipsets))

<a id="nestedatt--ipsets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipsets`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `external_ipset_id` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `raw_json` (String)
